name: Script Runner
description: Run your own PowerShell, Python or Bash scripts from the desktop: ones that finish (with exit code, time and output) and ones that keep running, like a tunnel or a server. Add them in Settings, give them a name, and press Run.
author: AmineChr54
changelog: Marked Windows only for now: on Linux, scripts picked as files, Start in and Run as administrator still expect Windows paths and prompts.

notify.label: Notify me

choices.label: When a script fails or stops on its own
When any script finishes or fails

notify.hint: Also switch on Allow notifications for this widget.

autoScript.label: Script to run automatically
autoScript.hint: The name of one of your scripts, e.g. Backup. Leave empty for button only. A script that keeps running has its own Start automatically switch on its row above.

runOnStart.label: Also run it when the widget starts

bigLine.label: Show the last output line big
bigLine.hint: For one-number dashboards: the last non-empty line of stdout becomes the headline.
